data.one_liner: Check if Google Mobile Services is available on the Android device.
data.what_it_does: Checks if Google Services are available on an Android device and defaults to true on other platforms. It prevents initializing unnecessary services that require Google Services.
use_when: You want to avoid initializing services that require Google Services on devices without them
You need to conditionally initialize Firebase services based on GMS availability
avoid_when: You do not use any Google Services or Firebase features in your app
strengths: Simple API with a single check method
Uses OptionalMethodChannel to prevent MissingPluginException on other platforms
weaknesses: Only checks availability on Android, returning true by default for other platforms
data.setup_notes: Call await GmsCheck().checkGmsAvailability() once before runApp in main().
